basic_info.description: Rarely available stunning LAUREL HEIGHTS single family home. Classic architecture throughout with an entry foyer leading to a spacious living room with a fireplace and a formal dining room. The fully equipped custom kitchen opens to the rear deck overlooking the manicured garden and brick patio. There are two spacious bedrooms and a remodeled bathroom that complete the main level. The lower level features a bonus room and a remodeled second bathroom. The large garage has ample storage and a side by side washer and dryer. There is a separate entrance to the lower level. The lovely rear garden, deck, and patio can be accessed from the kitchen or the separate street entrance. This pride of ownership home is adjacent to the Laurel Village Shopping Center and the Laurel Hill Playground. Also located in close proximity to The Presidio, the SF Jewish Community Center, The University of San Francisco, Golden Gate Park, and the Geary Blvd and Clement Street Corridors, convenient shopping, and easy access to public transportation.
